stem:
Anil holds his hands beside a hot pan without touching it. His hands feel warm.

How does heat reach his hands?

options.text: Radiation — heat reaches his hands from the hot pan without contact.
Conduction — heat passes only through contacting solid parts.
Convection — pan particles themselves move into his hands.
Conduction — any warmth from a hot pan is conduction.

teacher.key_rationale: Heat from a hot pan to nearby hands without contact is radiation.
